observations: Photo 0 shows a white industrial sewing machine with a blue accent strip and the brand name 'JUKI' clearly visible on the front.
The machine has a digital control panel with buttons labeled 'P', 'S', and directional arrows.
There is a warning label and a QR code on the front panel.
Photo 1 shows the same machine placed on top of a cardboard box labeled 'MODEL: A4', 'MACHINE NO: 1', 'CONTENT: 1 PC', 'N.W: 33 kg', 'G.W: 38 kg', 'MEAS: 63x24.5x53 cm'.
The machine appears to be new or recently unpacked, as it is sitting on the open box and some plastic wrapping is visible under the needle plate.
The background in both photos suggests an outdoor or semi-outdoor setting, possibly a market or workshop area.

claims.claim: Brand New JUKI Computerized Industrial Straight Sewing Machine
claims.evidence: The machine appears new and is on its original box, but there is no visible proof of being 'brand new' such as unopened packaging, factory seal, or serial number verification. The plastic under the needle plate suggests recent unpacking, but not necessarily brand new.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have been used before
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on, threading, and stitching fabric, or a close-up of the serial number and factory seal.

risks.risk: Model A4 may not be a genuine JUKI model or may be a rebranded/replica
risks.proof: A close-up of the machine's serial number plate and a comparison with official JUKI model documentation.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic industrial sewing machine

risks.risk: Missing accessories or parts (e.g., foot pedal, power cord, manual)
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the machine.

proof_requests: A video of the machine in operation, including power-on, threading, and stitching.
A close-up photo of the serial number plate on the machine.
A photo showing all included accessories (foot pedal, power cord, manual, etc.).
Proof of original packaging or factory seal if available.
response.reason: The machine is identified as a JUKI model A4, but the 'brand new' claim cannot be verified from the photos alone. There are hidden risks regarding functionality, authenticity, and completeness. Proof is needed to confirm the machine's condition and authenticity before pricing.
